description: This file contains implementation code for managing Netlink communication within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes functions for serializing and deserializing Netlink messages, sending and receiving data over sockets, and handling netlink message frames. The code deals with leveraging Linux's rtnetlink interface and managing asynchronous message exchanges.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Represents a Netlink message with serialization and deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current Netlink object into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte stream into the Netlink object.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Manages socket communication for Netlink messages, including sending and receiving data asynchronously.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message and waits for a response or timeout.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message and receives a response in a single operation.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Packages and sends pending Netlink messages over the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data frames from the socket, updating pending message states.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state change events (empty implementation).
